forecast_guard.rule: formula forecast counts as 'guarded' only if the fit tracks the last 3 days within 25% median relative error (tnn_ppf.TAIL_MAX)
forecast_guard.note: chosen after seeing the 2026-10-12 backtest (all fits 25% vs repeat-today 20%); scores of forecasts issued before the adoption date are post-hoc. Forward scores ('since 13 Oct') use only forecasts issued on or after it.
